contract: OffsetForLeaderEpoch returns the exclusive end of a stored epoch, or the log end when that epoch is current.
Truncation at or above the high watermark removes the divergent suffix. Truncation below the high watermark is refused.
A seeded failover keeps committed ids once, with unique offsets, and does not expose the truncated epoch.
Reopen restores the high watermark and the truncated log.
limits: This is not the OffsetForLeaderEpoch RPC and it does not replicate over the network.
The journal format is the local PLRCVR01 record, not an Apache leader-epoch checkpoint.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
